# Vendored data

`quran-morphology.txt.gz` is gzipped `quran-morphology.txt` from
[mustafa0x/quran-morphology](https://github.com/mustafa0x/quran-morphology) at commit
`8f38b39016824284f9ed16ae15069ff9102c4acf` (SHA-256 of the uncompressed file
`742bfac59941b2cb09736d5b7aae694af50792261fb8450cbf6afafcc340645f`).

It is a corrected, Arabic-script fork of the
[Quranic Arabic Corpus](https://corpus.quran.com) morphology v0.4 (GNU GPL). The
corpus terms require that its source is clearly indicated with a link to
https://corpus.quran.com; the app credits it in Settings (Credits.plist), the macOS
Credits.html, and the Android credits screen.

`build.py` reads it to add a verified root for every word of the Quran.
